## Important

The new `>` contradicts “at least the configured number of approvals” at `zzz-release/gate.py:1`; existing tests cover only values above and below the threshold. Restore `>=` and add an equality-boundary regression test. — Releases meeting the configured minimum require an extra approval to proceed.
